subject: trumbull
name: Trumbull V4 try 2: precise architectural watercolor

styleSelection.reason: Warm limestone planes and fitted architectural edges carry the image; keep the V096 light-to-dark paint ladder and use sepia ink only on the target's hard structural lines.

families.referenceCue: Cool blue, lightly variegated sky visible above and between the roof silhouettes; one connected soft first wash, with the roof edge kept dry.
Broad, sunlit golden limestone gable and tower; pale wall planes with crisp arched openings and deeper eave turns.
Receding left stone wing in cooler shade, with a few dark rectangular window groups.
Right stone wing and low connector, with shaded roof planes and small window grids.
Irregular green tree mass against the right facade; retain a few broken light gaps and avoid separate round leaf stamps.
Narrow ground, curb and street objects; keep their dark marks small and attached to the lower edge.
